SideSpeed 0.5.1 is a maintenance release with no changes to the apps. It exists to exercise **Update now** from 0.5.0.

On 0.5.0, open the Apps screen and press **Update now** on the update notice. See the [0.5.0 notes](https://github.com/DevJardins/SideSpeed/releases/tag/v0.5.0) for how updating works.

## Downloads
**On the TV:** open the Downloader app and enter code **3503400**, or go to `sidespeed.app/tv`. Both always get the latest SideSpeed APK.

**Companion:** open `sidespeed.app/phone` on your phone, or see [sidespeed.app](https://sidespeed.app) for the desktop installers.

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `SideSpeed-0.5.1.apk` (also as `SideSpeed.apk`) | The TV app (Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV with Fire OS) |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.5.1.apk` (also as `SideSpeed-Companion.apk`) | The companion for Android phones |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.5.1-macos-arm64.dmg` | The companion for macOS (Apple silicon) |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.5.1-windows-x64.msi` | The companion for Windows |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.5.1-linux-amd64.deb` / `-x86_64.rpm` | The companion for Linux |
